title: Gaussian Integration by Parts for Affine Polynomials
statement:
For every real polynomial $p$ and all real numbers $a,b$,
\[
\int_{\mathbb R} y\,p(a+by)\,d\gamma(y)=b\int_{\mathbb R}p'(a+by)\,d\gamma(y),
\]
where $\gamma$ is the standard Gaussian probability measure.
